'''Jurah Haret''' is [[innkeeper]] of [[The Star]] in [[Tear]]. The inn has a weaver's shop on one side and the smithy run by [[Dermid Ajala]] on the other.

==Appearance==
He is round-faced and balding, with a stout belly. He wears a long, deep blue coat and loose breeches. Like many of the residents of Tear at the time, his face had a look of weary resignation.

==Activites==
[[Lan]] chooses The Star inn for the party looking for [[Rand]] in Tear. Jurah shows them to their rooms.{{ref/book|3|50}}

He allows two women to leave a "surprise" for [[Moiraine]] which is really a [[hedgehog]]-shaped ''[[ter'angreal]]'' designed to trap the victim in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]''. [[Faile]] springs the trap instead and [[Perrin]] goes in after her with [[Loial]] standing guard.{{ref/book|3|53}}
